function.name: state_update
function.description: Update session defaults (charge, multiplicity, method, basis, solvent, current_geom, etc.) in a uniform way.

function.name: state_get_tool_args
function.description: Fetch all arguments needed for a specific MCP tool using current session state (injects geometry_xyz and defaults).

overrides.description: Optional explicit overrides to apply on top of state defaults.

function.name: name_to_geometry_xyz
function.description: Resolve a chemical name to an initial 3D geometry (XYZ without natoms/comment). Uses web services (OPSIN/PubChem) and converts SDF->XYZ. Stores provenance in result.

name.description: Chemical name, e.g. acetone, methanol, caffeine.

function.name: build_coordination_complex
function.description: Build a starting 3D geometry for a coordination complex from a metal center and a list of ligands. Monodentate ligands (NH3, H2O, Cl, CO) each occupy one site. Bidentate ligands (en, bipyridine, acac) are auto-detected and consume two adjacent sites. Total denticity must match the coordination number of the chosen geometry. Use output_id to route the geometry to the next node (run_opt_job).

metal.description: Element symbol of the metal center, e.g. 'Fe', 'Ru', 'Co', 'Pt'.

ligands.description: List of ligand names or SMILES. Monodentate ligands each occupy one site; bidentate ones (two donors within 1.8-5 A) occupy two adjacent sites. The total denticity must equal the coordination number.

geometry.description: Coordination geometry. Determines the coordination number: linear=2, trigonal_planar=3, tetrahedral/square_planar=4, trigonal_bipyramidal=5, octahedral=6.

multiplicity.description: Spin multiplicity (2S+1). Use 1 for closed-shell, higher for open-shell metals.

bond_length.description: Metal-donor bond length in Angstrom (default 2.0, suitable for first-row transition metals with N/O donors).

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.
GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

function.name: run_sp_energy
function.description: Run a single-point energy calculation. Returns energy_eh and homo_lumo_gap_ev (KS orbital gap in eV; null if not parsed).

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

function.name: run_freq_job
function.description: Run an ORCA frequency calculation. Returns electronic energy E, enthalpy H, and Gibbs free energy G (all in Eh). Use after geometry optimization to obtain thermodynamic properties.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

function.name: run_spectrum_job
function.description: Run an ORCA frequency + vibrational spectrum calculation. Returns the same E/H/G as run_freq_job PLUS ir_spectrum (list of {mode, freq_cm1, intensity_km_mol}) and optionally raman_spectrum (list of {mode, freq_cm1, activity, depolarization}). Use on an already-optimised geometry.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

spectrum_type.description: ir = IR only; raman / ir_raman = IR + Raman (adds %elprop Polar 1, roughly 2x cost).

function.name: run_tddft_job
function.description: Run an ORCA TD-DFT excited-state calculation on an already-optimised geometry. Returns energy_ground_state_eh, homo_lumo_gap_ev (KS orbital gap in eV), and excited_states list with energy_ev, wavelength_nm, oscillator_strength per state. Use run_opt_job first.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

n_states.description: Number of excited singlet states to compute (default 5; increase for broader spectral coverage).

function.name: run_scan_job
function.description: Run a rigid ORCA surface scan: vary one or more internal coordinates (bond/angle/dihedral) and compute SP energy at each point. Returns scan_results list with {step, value, energy_eh} for every geometry, plus min_energy_eh and min_value.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id of the starting geometry.

scan_coords.description: JSON array of scan coordinate dicts. Each dict: {"type":"B"|"A"|"D", "atoms":[i,j,...], "start":float, "end":float, "n_points":int}. type: B=bond(Å), A=angle(deg), D=dihedral(deg). atoms: 0-based ORCA indices (2 for B, 3 for A, 4 for D). Example: '[{"type":"B","atoms":[0,1],"start":0.8,"end":1.8,"n_points":11}]'

function.name: run_ts_opt_job
function.description: Run an ORCA transition-state optimisation (OptTS) on a geometry near the TS (e.g., the PES maximum from run_scan_job). calc_hess=true (default) adds Calc_Hess true, strongly recommended for reliable TS searches. Returns geometry_xyz (optimised TS structure), energy_eh, and ts_converged.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id of the TS candidate geometry (e.g., PES maximum from run_scan_job).

calc_hess.description: Add Calc_Hess true to %geom block. Required for reliable OptTS; set false only if Hessian already provided.

function.name: run_solvator_cluster
function.description: Build an explicit-solvent cluster (water) around a solute using ORCA SOLVATOR. Returns cluster geometry only (no thermochemistry). Use run_freq_job on the output cluster to get E/H/G.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nsolv.description: Number of water molecules to add around the solute.

job_label.description: Optional label. If omitted, the server will generate one.

function.name: run_solvator_cluster_thermo
function.description: Combined tool: build microsolvated cluster with SOLVATOR then run ORCA frequency for E/H/G. Prefer using run_solvator_cluster + run_freq_job separately for more control.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nsolv.description: Number of water molecules to add around the solute.

wall_timeout_seconds.description: Soft wall-clock timeout hint; host may ignore.

job_label.description: Optional label for this SOLVATOR job. If omitted, the server will generate one.

function.name: structure_add_remove_proton
function.description: Add or remove one proton (H) from a geometry. Geometry, charge and multiplicity are read from the GeometryRegistry via input_geom_id (do NOT specify them). The tool auto-selects the site by default. Returns edited XYZ with updated charge.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

h_index.description: Optional: index of H to remove (auto-detected if omitted).

target_atom_index.description: Optional: index of atom to protonate (auto-detected if omitted).

function.name: run_casscf_job
function.description: Run a CASSCF single-point calculation with ORCA. Requires specifying the active space: nel (number of active electrons) and norb (number of active orbitals). Set nroots > 1 for state-averaged SA-CASSCF over multiple roots. Returns energy_eh (total or SA-average energy) and energies_eh list when nroots > 1. Use after geometry optimization.

input_geom_id.description: GeometryRegistry id to read xyz/charge/multiplicity from.

nel.description: Number of active electrons in the CAS active space, e.g. 5 for Fe(III) d5.

norb.description: Number of active orbitals in the CAS active space, e.g. 5 for Fe d-orbitals.

nroots.description: Number of roots for state-averaged SA-CASSCF (default 1 = single-state CASSCF).

function.name: geom_update
function.description: Update geometry metadata/electronic state (rename, add alias, set charge/multiplicity) and optionally set it as current.

ref.description: Geometry id or alias/name. If omitted, uses current.

set_current.description: If true, set this geometry as current.
